newsitem.title: USA: AMR Corp declines to comment on plane order.
newsitem.headline: AMR Corp declines to comment on plane order.

text.p: AMR Corp, the parent of American Airlines, declined to comment Wednesday on media reports that it will announce on Thursday an order for up to $6 billion in Boeing Co aircraft.
AMR previously said it planned to replace its McDonnell Douglas Corp MD-11s, the largest and longest-range aircraft in its fleet, and might acquire 757s to service its domestic routes.
AMR's board is meeting today, but the company declined to comment on the agenda.

The board of American Airlines' pilots union is also meeting today to vote on a tentative labor pact reached in September. Approval of the labor deal is seen as a prerequisite for American's aircraft order.
